eyebrow: Squad Campaign Report · Arabia ×4 · vs Hard AI · 2026-07-25
title: One Saturday, four battles.
sub: Four team games, four defeats — a 29-minute collapse, a 99-minute war lost by two minutes in a base race, a concession from a winning position, and a wall fight that broke the same way. The pattern never changed: we don't lose fair fights — we lose the clock. New in this edition: the per-villager ledger, and the build-order critique it produced.

tiles.s: two of them competitive to the very end
objects destroyed (units, buildings, farms — all causes)
zero blacksmith techs clicked before 22:00, all four games

g1.title: The Collapse
g1.sum: Over in 29:09. Two of our three Castle arrivals landed after minute 26 — studious's Castle Age arrived at 29:11, two seconds after the game ended. The one real fight (27:00, on our ground) was all-Feudal against Castle-age armies: −193 for +158, and done.
moments: studious clicks Feudal — fastest opening of the whole day.
ricky clicks Castle (arrives 21:58) — the only on-pace player.
Olive clicks Castle at a time that would be fine… in a 50-minute game.
The only battle: −193 / +158 at our base. Feudal spears vs Castle armies.

g2.title: The War
g2.sum: 99 minutes, 16 attrition windows, and the day's big lesson. We bled through a failed mid-game campaign deep on their side, then our Imperial tech finally landed — and the fights flipped: won at 65:00, won at 81:00, won the 86–96min megabattle on their ground. While we won the field, home fell: lost the base race by ~2 minutes.
moments: ricky clicks Castle (arrives 19:30), then builds the day's only real gold engine: 29 trade carts.
The failed campaign begins on their side — five brutal windows, ~−600 gross over 15 min.
Olive's Bracer/Iron Casting finally land. Every major fight after this point: won.
We win the biggest battle of the day (+521/−468, their side) — as our own base burns.
Home falls. Defeat at 99:20. The army was right; it was 20 minutes late.

g3.title: The Concession
g3.sum: We quit at 47:31 because the AI hit Imperial first — while our field record stood at 2 wins, 0 losses, 2 trades, +203/−65. Two minutes before the GG, ricky's fresh Imperial army had just razed 120 enemy objects for 2 lost on their side of the map. This one was still alive.
moments: ricky's fastest Feudal click of his day (arrives 10:24). Cleanest opening in game 3.
Olive's best Castle click of the day — the week's trend keeps improving.
ricky enters Imperial. The window where fights flip is opening…
−2 / +120 on their side. The best single window our squad produced all day.
GG typed. Field record at that moment: 2W·0L·2T. The data votes: play it out.

g4.title: The Wall
g4.sum: Defeat in 49:36 despite a 3W·1L·1T field record. The AI's push hit at ~22:00 — the wall fight — while all three of us were still in Feudal; Castle arrivals landed 29:01–30:22, including ricky's regression (27:42 click after a militia-opening experiment). We out-fought them late, again; the damage from minute 22 decided it, again.
moments: Olive clicks Loom… then cancels it. It gets re-clicked at 37:21 — the cancel habit in one line.
Five of ricky's villagers sit housed until 21:25 — the militia opening starved house wood.
The wall fight. Olive throws up a forward Archery Range mid-attack — its three builders die with it (the villager ledger caught them).
ricky's Castle click — his slowest of the day after three games under 19:20.

bo.studiousmonkey1: The ledger's verdict: world-class first minute, leaky everything-after. Loom by 0:20 in all four games (0:08 in G4!) and houses up before most players' first command — then the mining camp waits until 17:13–20:07 every single game and the TC runs at 44–49% uptime. Zero TC resource rallies set all day; new villagers stack up untasked at the TC. Your opening deserves the follow-through.
bo.rickyflows: Textbook camps (lumber ~2:20, mine as early as 8:32) and the only player who sets a TC resource rally — 3 of 4 games, and your birth-idle is ≈0 when you do vs 3,583s the one game you didn't. That habit is proven; keep it. The leaks: Loom never in two games, and the G4 militia experiment — five villagers housed 13:33→21:25 and your only slow Castle (27:42).
bo.Olive: Huns start with −100 wood — and your lumber camp went down at 6:26 / 8:11 / 7:34 in three of four games, the single biggest drag on your Feudal. Loom: never, never, or ~36:00 (the 3:31 click in G4 was cancelled — the ledger proves it, and it's a habit: two Wheelbarrow cancels this week). You bank population instead of clicking up: 35–47 villagers queued before each Castle click. The smith went up by ~13:00 twice — and zero smith techs were clicked before 20:00 in any game. Zero TC rallies; ~5,000s of proven birth idle in G1 alone.

advice.name: studiousmonkey1
advice.ev: Fastest Feudal player and fastest Loom on the team (0:08–0:20, every game), with the day's best army quality — the G2 Mangudai + Trebuchet force. But it sat on the thinnest economy: 29 / 48 / 36 / 30 villagers, TC uptime 44–49% every game.
fx: The TC never idles — and gets a rally. You set zero TC resource rallies all day; every batch of new villagers stood around. Rally to wood and forget it.
Mining camp by 12:00. It came after 17:13 in all four games — that's the lid on your Castle timing.
Second TC at your Castle click. Your opening is elite — bank it into economy, not just tech.

advice.name: rickyflows
advice.ev: Fastest Castle in three of four games (16:50 / 18:49 / 19:18), the only player to reach Imperial (twice), builder of the only trade network (29 carts, G2), and the only player who rallies his TC — the habit that zeroes birth idle. G4 was the off-game: militia opening, 27:42 Castle.
fx: Spend the lead. You're now the team's biggest floater — G1 ended with 4,496 banked and 16 army trained all game. Upgrades and production, every surplus.
Loom before 5:00. Never-clicked in two games; your villagers fight raids naked.
Retire the militia opening, keep the trade. G4's experiment cost 5 housed villagers and your only slow Castle; G2's 29 carts funded the comeback — make that the standard.

advice.name: Olive
advice.ev: The team's production engine all four games — 1,210 units across the day, most on the team — the most aggressive map presence (23% of attack orders on their side), and the resource float from last week is provably gone. The leaks have moved upstream: the opening and the blacksmith.
fx: Lumber camp by 4:00, Loom for real. Huns start −100 wood — the camp can't wait until 6:26. And stop cancelling techs (3:31 Loom → cancelled; two Wheelbarrow cancels this week).
Click the smith pair by 14:00. The building was up by ~13:00 twice and the techs never followed — zero by 20:00 in four straight games. G2 proved fights flip when they land.
Stop banking population. 35–47 villagers queued before each Castle click — click at ~30 and the age arrives five minutes sooner. Set a TC rally while you're there.
